title: Spring actuator /actuator/beans is exposed
summary: A Spring Boot actuator endpoint is open to the internet and reveals how the application is wired and configured.

confirm.control: A path that cannot exist, so the site's not found answer is known.
confirm.differential: status==200 and "json" in header("content-type") and body_matches("\"beans\"\\s*:\\s*[\\[{]") and (body_contains("\"contexts\"") or body_contains("\"context\"")) and body_differs(control)

remediate: Lock the actuator endpoints down to an internal network or require authentication (management.endpoints.web.exposure).
